// Assessment-only actual-handler responses. No listener, real data or consumer reads.
package main

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "net/http/httptest"
 "net/url"
 "os"

 "github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/catalog"
 "github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
)

type response struct { Status int; Headers map[string][]string; Body string }
type routes struct { List, Detail, Stale, Invalid, Reset string }
func main() {
 c,err:=catalog.Default();if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 stale:="0"+c.Revision[1:];if stale==c.Revision {stale="1"+c.Revision[1:]}
 out:=struct { Revision string; Routes map[string]routes; Responses map[string]response }{c.Revision,map[string]routes{},map[string]response{}}
 h:=gallery.New()
 capture:=func(path string,status int){r:=httptest.NewRecorder();h.ServeHTTP(r,httptest.NewRequest("GET","http://127.0.0.1"+path,nil));if r.Code!=status {panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d, want%d",path,r.Code,status))};out.Responses[path]=response{r.Code,r.Header(),r.Body.String()}}
 for _,theme:=range []string{"light","dark"}{
  q:=url.Values{"q":{"analytics"},"profile":{"go-web"},"layer":{"L3b"},"kind":{"recipe"},"maturity":{"experimental"},"limit":{"10"},"theme":{theme}}
  list:="/catalog?"+q.Encode();q.Set("expected_revision",c.Revision)
  detail:="/catalog/analytics.comparison?"+q.Encode();q.Set("expected_revision",stale);q.Set("cursor","old-page")
  old:="/catalog/analytics.comparison?"+q.Encode()
  q.Set("limit","0");q.Set("profile","not-a-profile")
  invalid:="/catalog/analytics.comparison?"+q.Encode();reset:="/catalog?theme="+theme
  out.Routes[theme]=routes{list,detail,old,invalid,reset}
  capture(list,200);capture(detail,200);capture(old,409);capture(invalid,409);capture(reset,200)
 }
 capture("/static/app.css",200)
 if err:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(out);err!=nil {panic(err)}
}
